mapper.select: SELECT ds.id FROM duty_shift ds JOIN incident_assignment ia ON ia.id = ds.incident_assignment_id WHERE ds.operational_period_id = #{opId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND ia.account_id = #{accountId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND ia.revoked_at IS NULL AND ds.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY ds.started_at DESC, ds.id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO search_path ( id, duty_shift_id, account_id, status, started_at, ended_at, geometry, version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{dutyShiftId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{accountId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{status}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt}, ST_GeomFromEWKT(#{geometry,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.JtsGeometryTypeHandler}), #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO search_path_lifecycle_event ( id, search_path_id, event_type, client_ts, server_received_at, version, created_at ) VALUES ( #{id,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{searchPathId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{eventType}, #{clientTs}, #{serverReceivedAt}, #{version}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, search_path_id, event_type, client_ts, server_received_at, version, created_at FROM search_path_lifecycle_event WHERE search_path_id = #{pathId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} ORDER BY version ASC, client_ts ASC, id ASC
mapper.sql: sp.id, op.incident_id, ds.operational_period_id AS op_id, sp.duty_shift_id, sp.account_id, sp.status, sp.started_at, sp.ended_at, sp.version, sp.created_at, sp.updated_at
FROM search_path sp JOIN duty_shift ds ON ds.id = sp.duty_shift_id JOIN operational_period op ON op.id = ds.operational_period_id
mapper.select:
SELECT , ST_AsEWKT(sp.geometry) AS geometry
WHERE sp.id = #{id,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}

SELECT sp.id, op.incident_id, ds.operational_period_id AS op_id, sp.duty_shift_id, sp.account_id, sp.status, sp.started_at, sp.ended_at, sp.version, sp.created_at, sp.updated_at
WHERE sp.id = #{id,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} FOR UPDATE OF sp
mapper.sql:
SELECT , CASE WHEN detail.kind = -1 THEN ST_AsEWKT(sp.geometry) END AS geometry, (detail.gps).point_order AS gps_point_order, (detail.gps).point_id AS gps_point_id, (detail.gps).client_ts AS gps_client_ts, (detail.gps).lon AS gps_lon, (detail.gps).lat AS gps_lat, (detail.gps).speed_mps AS gps_speed_mps, (detail.gps).horizontal_accuracy_m AS gps_horizontal_accuracy_m, (detail.gps).location_provider AS gps_location_provider, (detail.gps).elapsed_realtime_nanos AS gps_elapsed_realtime_nanos, (detail.segment).id AS segment_id, (detail.segment).search_path_id AS segment_search_path_id, (detail.segment).movement_type AS segment_movement_type, (detail.segment).movement_type_source AS segment_movement_type_source, ST_AsEWKT((detail.segment).geometry) AS segment_geometry, (detail.segment).started_at AS segment_started_at, (detail.segment).ended_at AS segment_ended_at, (detail.segment).corrected_by_account_id AS segment_corrected_by_account_id, (detail.segment).corrected_at AS segment_corrected_at, (detail.segment).version AS segment_version, (detail.segment).start_point_order AS segment_start_point_order, (detail.segment).end_point_order AS segment_end_point_order, (detail.segment).last_changed_path_version AS segment_last_changed_path_version, (detail.segment).created_at AS segment_created_at, (detail.segment).updated_at AS segment_updated_at, (detail.excluded).id AS excluded_id, (detail.excluded).search_path_id AS excluded_search_path_id, (detail.excluded).point_id AS excluded_point_id, (detail.excluded).reason AS excluded_reason, (detail.excluded).client_ts AS excluded_client_ts, (detail.excluded).lon AS excluded_lon, (detail.excluded).lat AS excluded_lat, (detail.excluded).speed_mps AS excluded_speed_mps, (detail.excluded).horizontal_accuracy_m AS excluded_horizontal_accuracy_m, (detail.excluded).location_provider AS excluded_location_provider, (detail.excluded).elapsed_realtime_nanos AS excluded_elapsed_realtime_nanos, (detail.excluded).created_at AS excluded_created_at, (detail.excluded).updated_at AS excluded_updated_at
LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT -1 AS kind, NULL::integer AS point_order, NULL::timestamptz AS sort_time, NULL::uuid AS sort_id, NULL::search_path_gps_point AS gps, NULL::search_path_segment AS segment, NULL::search_path_excluded_point AS excluded UNION ALL SELECT 0, gps.point_order, NULL, NULL, gps, NULL::search_path_segment, NULL::search_path_excluded_point FROM search_path_gps_point gps WHERE gps.search_path_id = sp.id UNION ALL SELECT 1, NULL, segment.started_at, segment.id, NULL::search_path_gps_point, segment, NULL::search_path_excluded_point FROM search_path_segment segment WHERE segment.search_path_id = sp.id UNION ALL SELECT 2, NULL, excluded.client_ts, excluded.id, NULL::search_path_gps_point, NULL::search_path_segment, excluded FROM search_path_excluded_point excluded WHERE excluded.search_path_id = sp.id ) detail ON TRUE
ORDER BY sp.updated_at DESC, sp.id ASC, detail.kind ASC, detail.point_order ASC, detail.sort_time ASC, detail.sort_id ASC
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 WHERE AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM search_path_segment s WHERE s.search_path_id = sp.id AND (s.start_point_order IS NULL OR s.end_point_order IS NULL OR s.last_changed_path_version IS NULL OR s.last_changed_path_version > sp.version)) OR (sp.geometry IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM search_path_gps_point g WHERE g.search_path_id = sp.id)) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM search_path_gps_point g WHERE g.search_path_id = sp.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM search_path_segment s WHERE s.search_path_id = sp.id)) ) )

INSERT INTO search_path_gps_point ( search_path_id, point_order, point_id, client_ts, lon, lat, speed_mps, horizontal_accuracy_m, location_provider, elapsed_realtime_nanos, created_at ) VALUES
( #{pathId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{pointOffset} + #{index}, #{point.pointId}, #{point.clientTs}, #{point.lon}, #{point.lat}, #{point.speedMps}, #{point.horizontalAccuracyM}, #{point.locationProvider}, #{point.elapsedRealtimeNanos}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT point_id, client_ts, lon, lat, speed_mps, horizontal_accuracy_m, location_provider, elapsed_realtime_nanos FROM search_path_gps_point WHERE search_path_id = #{pathId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} ORDER BY point_order ASC
SELECT COALESCE(( SELECT point_order + 1 FROM search_path_gps_point WHERE search_path_id = #{pathId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} ORDER BY point_order DESC LIMIT 1 ), 0)

( #{segment.id,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{segment.searchPathId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, NULLIF(#{segment.startIndex}, -1), NULLIF(#{segment.endIndex}, -1), #{segment.lastChangedPathVersion}, #{segment.movementType}, #{segment.movementTypeSource}, ST_GeomFromEWKT(#{segment.geometry,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.JtsGeometryTypeHandler}), #{segment.startedAt}, #{segment.endedAt}, #{segment.correctedByAccountId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{segment.correctedAt}, #{segment.version}, #{segment.createdAt}, #{segment.updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, search_path_id, start_point_order, end_point_order, last_changed_path_version, movement_type, movement_type_source, ST_AsEWKT(geometry) AS geometry, started_at, ended_at, corrected_by_account_id, corrected_at, version, created_at, updated_at FROM search_path_segment WHERE id = #{id,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}

SELECT id, search_path_id, start_point_order, end_point_order, last_changed_path_version, movement_type, movement_type_source, ST_AsEWKT(geometry) AS geometry, started_at, ended_at, corrected_by_account_id, corrected_at, version, created_at, updated_at FROM search_path_segment WHERE search_path_id = #{pathId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC
